svg.title: PoseForge architecture
svg.desc: Codex, Antigravity, Dreamina, OpenAI, Gemini, Replicate, fal.ai, Higgsfield and ComfyUI all connect to PoseForge. Characters, poses, history and metrics stay on your own machine, so you can switch providers without losing anything.
svg.text: P95 latency, queue wait, success rate
LOCAL POSE-TRANSFER PIPELINE · SAME INPUTS FOR EVERY PROVIDER
Switch to any provider — your characters, poses, history and metrics never move.
Identity lives in PoseForge, not in a provider account, so characters stay consistent across images and videos. Only the references, prompt and settings you choose are sent to a provider.
